'''''King Darith and the Fall of the House of-''''' is the incomplete name of a story mentioned once by [[Thom]] during his first meeting with [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Mat Cauthon]], [[Perrin Aybara]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|1|4}}

==Parallels==

* The story may be a reference to the Edgard Allen Poe short story [https://poestories.com/read/houseofusher The Fall of the House of Usher].
